$comment: Every refetchInterval and setInterval in apps/web/src, plus all timers in the public visitor scripts, one entry per site. A site is <file>#<enclosing function or variable>; list a site twice if it occurs twice. Polling is the last resort: prefer a socket event, or a refetch when the user acts. Checked by bun run perf:guards; see docs/performance.md.

sites.why: Retry backoff only after an explicit comment-panel read or submission; stops within 90 seconds to allow gateway verification, routing and device response deadlines; panel reads cancel their request and backoff on close or replacement, with no background refresh.
Cancels one isolated human check after two minutes; completion or closing the panel clears it and removes the frame.
Re-measures comment marker positions each second while annotations are shown; no request.
Waits every 3 s, only while a setup row is open and nothing in it has connected, for a Cloud agent to finish signing in; nothing pushes that event.
Waits every 3 s for an agent to first use the token made for it during setup.
Follows the open tab's pairing code every 2 s until it is verified, failed or expired.
Quick connect: follows a pairing code every 2 s until it is verified, failed or expired.
Always-on setup: follows a pairing code every 2 s until it is verified, failed or expired.
Cloud backup history while Settings shows it: 5 s during a backup or restore, 30 s otherwise; the control plane has no socket.
Cloud link status every 3 s, only while the Cloud section is open, to catch a sign-in finished in another window.
Export progress while a job is queued or running; stops when it ends.
Import progress while a job is verifying, preparing or replacing; stops when it ends.
Re-reads the version once its cached update check expires, only while the System section is open.
Follows a self-update every 2 s while it is in flight.
Waits for /health to return on the new version while a self-update restarts the server.
Countdown clock in the clear-workspace dialog; no request.
Clear progress every second while a clear is preparing or replacing.
Export progress app-wide while a job runs, to announce it when done; stops when it ends.
Import progress app-wide while a job runs, to announce it when done; stops when it ends.
Clear progress app-wide while a job runs, to announce it when done; stops when it ends.
Checks the workspace identity every 15 s only when no socket is live and the tab is visible.
Follows a storage upgrade at start until the workspace is ready; never polls after that.
Desktop update state lives in the native shell, which cannot push to the page: 1.5 s during an update, 60 s otherwise.
Reads the server's cached update check: briefly fast at start until the first check lands, then slow.
Activity: 60 s check only while its Space has no live socket (Home and workspace-wide lists).
Paged activity: 60 s check only while its Space has no live socket.
Pending: 60 s check only while its Space has no live socket.
Recent: 60 s check only while its Space has no live socket.
Only while there is no Space yet, so no socket to hear spaces_changed: 60 s.
Asks again every 2 s only while the server says its search index is still building.
Updates Home's date heading each minute; no request.
Bounded retry backoff: data calls stop within 25 seconds and waking checks stop within one minute; there is no unbounded retry loop.

Checks collection hints every 30 seconds with jitter only while a visible tool has subscriptions and interaction within ten minutes; visibility resumes one immediate check and navigation stops the broker.
One check a second after the initial frame load detects a failed SDK handshake; it does not repeat after the tool starts.
